question: Selling price of an article is Rs. 817. If loss percentage is 14 percent, then what is the cost price of the article?
solution:

The selling price of an article is Rs. 817.

The loss percentage is 14 percent

Concept used:

SP + loss= CP 

Profit = CP × (Profit percentage / 100)
